captions.linkedin:
Industries change. The approach travels.

My work has crossed retail, construction, real estate and housing technology. As the Wiz chain grew, I built an in-house construction and fixture company. After the Wiz, I moved into waterfront revitalization and real estate. Today I lead JemRock Organization and BUILT®.

What traveled: a clear identity, market-gap thinking, repeatable systems and location judgment. What changed: the rules (zoning and approvals), the teams and the tools.

Five questions for any new industry: What is the brand promise? What need isn't being served? What can be repeated? Who has to approve it? Which tools make it faster?
